verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no machine or agent identity capability, such as service accounts, per-agent credentials with scoped permissions, or instant per-identity revocation. What exists are developer building blocks: user-management APIs, RLS row-level scoping, custom access-token claims, refresh-token reuse detection and JWT expiry. A developer could assemble these into something similar, but they are not the capability the story asks for, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can give each agent its own least-privilege machine identity with narrowly scoped permissions and instant revocation, instead of sharing a human's credentials
